title: A New Language for the Natural Light: Translating the New Philosophy in the Dutch Early Enlightenment (1640-1720)
descriptions: This archive contains the software and the two main subcorpora developed and collected for my PhD thesis: 'A New Language for the Natural Light: Translating the New Philosophy in the Dutch Early Enlightenment (1640-1720)' (2022). More information and documentation can be found in the thesis or on GitHub: https://github.com/lucasvanderdeijl.
